content:
“You can just hear those sweet, sweet zines!”

**Pannapictagraphist** is a Perception-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Players will hear directional audio when near a magazine. The sound is the same as the one made when a magazine is used.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | You hear directional audio when in range of a Magazine. | 003E956E | 

- Works well in conjunction with the Curator perk.
- A "pannapictagraphist" is someone who collects comic books.
